title: Segment inspector
blurb: Compares raw getPathData() against getPathData({ normalize: true }) side by side for any SVG d string, highlighting the focused segment directly on the vector preview.
question: How does getPathData({ normalize: true }) rewrite relative commands, H/V shorthands, quadratics, smooth cubics, and elliptical arcs into absolute M/L/C/Z segments?
result: Verified in Chrome 153 behind --enable-blink-features=SVGPathDataAPI: h/v convert to L, q/t/S convert to C, and arcs approximate to multiple C segments (not verified in Chrome 160).
testedIn: Chrome 153 behind --enable-blink-features=SVGPathDataAPI; not verified in Chrome 160
